subject: User authorized new notebook chat: text context retrieved, media access overclaimed
body: Ziggy explicitly changed the scope: create a new chat from/in the notebook rather than the existing Videos session. ONE text-only inquiry was submitted from Notebook2, producing https://gemini.google.com/app/ffc5580aa01acae1 / response eb565d4c1365afc1. All three existing notebook sources opened as copied text; Cancel used, no Save/uploads/source edits/settings changes/renders. Source citations and unseeded hashes/counts match independently read text, supporting text access. The model incorrectly called FACE-NATURAL, LOOK-V3 and T02MP4 explicitly attached/viewable in this fresh chat; none were uploaded and current binary/video access is unverified. Generator prompt/payload/tool call unexposed. Historical Oct8/9 rules/inventory are not evidence of current media or complete context sync. Original Videos chat content/mode untouched. Ziggy suggested a named-homeworld dogs/barking canary; SC14 already contains a dog, so proposed future test uses clean matched contexts, same animal-free immediate prompt with world cue, only one preload condition contains the dog rule. Score visual dog/collar and actual barking separately; verify audio support. One absence is inconclusive. Draft saved, ZERO test renders/new test notebooks/source edits. No new media ordered.
